mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invocation_message ( message_id, user_id, invocation_id, task_id, trace_id, agent_id, type, content, raw_payload, created_at ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{userId}, #{invocationId}, #{taskId}, #{traceId}, #{agentId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{raw, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.ObjectJsonTypeHandler}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), invocation_id = VALUES(invocation_id), task_id = VALUES(task_id), trace_id = VALUES(trace_id), agent_id = VALUES(agent_id), type = VALUES(type), content = VALUES(content), raw_payload = VALUES(raw_payload), created_at = VALUES(created_at)
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, user_id, invocation_id, task_id, trace_id, agent_id, type, content, raw_payload, created_at FROM invocation_message WHERE invocation_id = #{invocationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, message_id ASC

SELECT message_id, user_id, invocation_id, task_id, trace_id, agent_id, type, content, raw_payload, created_at FROM invocation_message WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, message_id ASC

SELECT message_id, user_id, invocation_id, task_id, trace_id, agent_id, type, content, raw_payload, created_at FROM invocation_message WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, message_id ASC
